# The blank line above is deliberate, and so are the extra spaces below.
root: 01a03d55-1a2b-7c3d-8e4f-5a6b7c8d9e0f
title:    Comments and blank lines inside the block
---

Comments and blank lines survive the preserving path, because that path re-emits bytes rather
than re-emitting YAML. They do not survive the canonical path, and that is correct: canonicalizing
is a rewrite, and no serde-lineage YAML emitter retains comments. This fixture is what tells the
two paths apart — a "preserving" writer that secretly round-tripped through the emitter would pass
every other fixture in this corpus and fail this one.
